summary.text: Doug Osowski is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 42 (Grand Forks) in the 2025-26 Legislative Assembly. The legislature's biography lists Doug Osowski's service as "House since 2025". The member page lists Doug Osowski's committee assignments as including the Education and the Transportation standing committees.

paragraphs.text: The biography lists Doug Osowski's occupation as Senior Systems Administration, ND University System.
It lists education as BS, MS, Industrial Technology.
It lists these affiliations and civic roles: Certificate of Appreciation (25 years), ND University System.
Doug Osowski is listed as married to Connie with 3 children.
